events.title: Steam Next Fest Update
events.summary: Our Steam Next Fest update is here, bringing new challenges!Abyss Floor 13 is now open! Venture deeper and take on the next challenge.The revamped Seven Deadly Sins is now available! Dive in and experience the rework.

events.title: We’re Joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Try our demo and let us know what you think. If you enjoy it, don’t forget to wishlist the game!
